name: [🥳X24 EVENT] +1 Aura Speed Escape
desc:
🎶  Welcome to +1 Aura Speed Escape  🎵

How To Play:
💥 Gain AURA every second you spend walking
😎 Beat the obstacles to earn RESPECT
💪 Train in the bench or the treadmil to increase your AURA
🤣 Unlock powerful multipliers and become the ULTIMATE AURA FARMER

🔥 EVOLUTION SYSTEM: Unlock new auras at specific level milestones!
🎬 PHONK EDIT: when you win respect or when you die

If you’re having fun, don’t forget to like the game! 👍
Join the group for Secret Reward! 👥

❓Speed Recommended to Beat Obstacles: 150–300 [🌍W1]
❓Speed Recommended to Beat Obstacles: 500–1000 [🌍W2]
❓Speed Recommended to Beat Obstacles: 1500–2500 [🌍W3]
